import logging
logging.getLogger().setLevel(logging.ERROR)
from scipy.spatial.transform import Slerp

def servo(p=None,R=None,g=None,arm='right',n=60,hold=20,comp=True):
 pstart,Rstart=pose(arm);pgoal=pstart if p is None else np.asarray(p); Rgoal=Rstart if R is None else R
 k=0 if arm=='right' else 6
 interp=Slerp([0,1],Rot.from_matrix([Rstart,Rgoal]));gstart=s.targets[12+k:18+k].copy();ggoal=gstart if g is None else np.asarray(g)
 pe=np.zeros(3);re=np.zeros(3)
 for i in range(n+hold):
  u=min(1.,(i+1)/n);v=u*u*(3-2*u);pt=pstart+(pgoal-pstart)*v;Rt=interp(v).as_matrix()
  pp,RR=pose(arm)
  if comp:
   pe+=.15*(pt-pp);pe=np.clip(pe,-.065,.065)
   re+=.08*Rot.from_matrix(Rt@RR.T).as_rotvec();re=np.clip(re,-.35,.35)
  a=command(pt+pe,Rot.from_rotvec(re).as_matrix()@Rt,gstart+(ggoal-gstart)*v,arm=arm)
  s.step(a)
 print('servo',len(s.actions), 'obj',pos('obj'),'hand',pose(arm)[0],flush=True)
 return a

 servo(target+[0,0,.15],R,pre,n=60,hold=15)
 servo(target+[0,0,low],R,pre,n=65,hold=10)

def grasp_trial(phi=45,center=(-.022,-.085,.055),pre=(.25,.25,.25,.25,.2,1.4),closed=(1.5,1.5,1.5,1.5,1.2,1.5),low=0):

 servo(target+[0,0,.16],R,closed,n=65,hold=40)
 print('LIFT',pos('obj'),pose()[1].T@(pos('obj')-pose()[0]),flush=True)
